tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards and lists.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, tab bar, sheets.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: chips at rest, info boxes, progress track, inline code.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta lines, captions, inactive tabs. Passes 4.5:1 on bg and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between list rows; resting chip borders.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: The bold 2px outline on buttons, cards, inputs and options: the Quode sticker look.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Beak yellow. Fill of the ONE primary action per screen, the active tab, the add button. Never text on bg.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent. Always dark, in both themes.

tokens.name: correct
tokens.usage: Correct answer, Got it outcome. Always paired with a label or icon.

tokens.name: correct-bg
tokens.usage: Background of a correct option or Got it result; text on it uses ink.

tokens.name: partial
tokens.usage: Partial outcome. Always paired with a label.

tokens.name: partial-bg
tokens.usage: Background of a Partial result; text on it uses ink.

tokens.name: missed
tokens.usage: Wrong pick, Missed outcome, errors. Orange, not red, so it differs from correct blue for colour-blind users.

tokens.name: missed-bg
tokens.usage: Background of a wrong option, Missed result or error box; text on it uses ink.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 3px, offset 2px.

styles.name: number-xl
styles.usage: The one big number on Today.

styles.name: question
styles.usage: The question prompt in a session.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card and section headings, list item titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Entries in the same bucket are chained.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code and code blocks inside questions and answers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between chips; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between buttons and list items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter; card inner padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gaps between sections on a screen; roomy card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Large vertical breaks (login, session done).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small controls: steppers, segmented controls, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, answer options.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, progress bars, the round add button.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Solid offset shadow on the primary action only. Pressed state removes it and moves the button 2px down-right.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Dividers and the tab bar top edge.

tokens.name: border-bold
tokens.usage: Outlines of buttons, cards, inputs and options.
